sources.finding: Publisher lists one 1.20.2 release, oculus-mc1.20.2-1.8.0.jar, tagged Forge; description requires Embeddium. No NeoForge-tagged file in this release list.
Original Oculus release list ends at Minecraft 1.20.1; no original 1.20.2 NeoForge file listed.
One 26.2 Forge community-port beta listed: 0.3.0-beta.1, uploaded Aug 16, 2026.
Porting plan explicitly leaves terrain/entity gbuffers open.

scope: Current publisher listing and documented source scope only. Absence in these lists is not a proof that no compatible fork exists; existing private NeoForge port and exact required configurations remain open.
